# Minecraft 26.2 — Spawn egg IDs (least → most powerful)

**Source:** Bukkit/Spigot `Material` enum for API **26.2** (`*_SPAWN_EGG`), cross-checked against Paper Material docs.  
**Count:** 88 spawn eggs.  
**IDs:** Bukkit enum + namespaced item id (`minecraft:<snake_case>`).

### Ranking criteria (subjective)

Power = how dangerous / impactful the **spawned mob** is in survival PvE, considering:

1. Combat DPS, HP, special attacks, and status effects  
2. Crowd / area control (explosions, projectiles, summons)  
3. Boss / raid-tier threat  
4. Player-side power when the mob is **allied or rideable** (mounts, golems, trading) — noted where it shifts placement  

This is not official Mojang balance. Ties within a band are ordered by typical threat, then alphabetical.

**Newer 26.x entries** called out: Mounts of Mayhem (`nautilus`, `zombie_nautilus`, `camel_husk`, `parched`) and Chaos Cubed (`sulfur_cube`).

# Minecraft 26.2 — Spawn eggs + mineral blocks (least → most powerful)

**Source:** Bukkit/Spigot `Material` enum for API **26.2** (`*_SPAWN_EGG` plus selected mineral blocks), cross-checked against Paper Material docs.  
**Count:** 88 spawn eggs + **3 mineral blocks** = **91** entries.  
**IDs:** Bukkit enum + namespaced item id (`minecraft:<snake_case>`).

### Ranking criteria (subjective)

For **mobs** (spawn eggs), power = survival PvE impact:

1. Combat DPS, HP, special attacks, and status effects  
2. Crowd / area control (explosions, projectiles, summons)  
3. Boss / raid-tier threat  
4. Player-side power when the mob is **allied or rideable** (mounts, golems, trading)

For **mineral blocks** (`IRON_BLOCK`, `EMERALD_BLOCK`, `DIAMOND_BLOCK`), power = condensed player progression value (gear tier, crafting unlocks, beacon pyramids, trading density) — not combat DPS of the block itself.

This is not official Mojang balance. Ties within a band are ordered by typical impact, then alphabetical.

**Newer 26.x spawn eggs** called out: Mounts of Mayhem (`nautilus`, `zombie_nautilus`, `camel_husk`, `parched`) and Chaos Cubed (`sulfur_cube`).

$kindMap = @{ egg = 'Spawn egg'; block = 'Block'; book = 'Enchanted book' }
for ($i = 0; $i -lt $n; $i++) {
  $e = $entries[$i]
  $rank = $i + 1
  $kind = $kindMap[$e.Type]
  $mat = if ($e.Type -eq 'book') { "``ENCHANTED_BOOK`` + ``$($e.Mat -replace 'ENCHANTED_BOOK \(|\)','')``" } else { "``$($e.Mat)``" }
  if ($e.Type -eq 'book') {
    $ench = if ($e.Ns -match '\{(.+)\}') { $Matches[1] } else { '?' }
    $mat = "``Enchantment.$($ench.ToUpper())``"
    $ns = "``minecraft:enchanted_book`` + ``minecraft:$ench``"
  } else {
    $ns = "``$($e.Ns)``"
  }
  $name = $e.Name -replace '\|','\|'
  $notes = $e.Notes -replace '\|','\|'
  if ($e.Type -eq 'book' -or $e.Type -eq 'block') {
    [void]$sb.AppendLine("| $rank | $kind | **$mat** | **$ns** | **$name** | $notes |")
  } else {
    [void]$sb.AppendLine("| $rank | $kind | $mat | $ns | $name | $notes |")
  }
}

## Free Lotto Ticket (RootMC)

Not a vanilla `Material`. Rank **31** -- `rootmc:free_lotto_ticket` is a RootMC reward / crate-style item tied to **Root-Gamble** `/lotto`.

### What redeeming it does

- Adds **one free-play credit** for lotto on the player account -- the same entitlement as when a player still has their **first unused** free lotto play.
- That credit makes the next `/lotto <number>` cost **0 G** instead of the configured ticket price (default **25 G** in `root-gamble.yml` `lotto.ticket-price`).
- After the free play is spent, Root-Gamble marks lotto free-play used (`gamble_free_play`, `game_id = lotto`). Redeeming another Free Lotto Ticket **puts a credit back** (clears / re-grants that unused free-play state) so they can take another complimentary ticket.
- Player still chooses a number and enters the draw with `/lotto`; the item is not itself a numbered slip.

### What it is not

- Not wallet Gold (does not mint G).
- Not an automatic jackpot entry -- redeem credit, then buy with `/lotto`.
- Not a multi-game voucher; credit is for **lotto** only (other games have their own one-time free plays).

### Why it ranks low-mid

Face value is one ticket (~25 G) plus jackpot upside, but lottery expected value is poor -- same tier as niche utility, not combat power.

---

## Quick tiers

| Tier | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| Bottom | Curses, base potions, useless/buff tipped arrows, ambient mobs |
| Low-mid | Livestock, free-lotto credit, plain/spectral arrows, utility potions, armor trims, mounts |
| Mid-high | Offensive tipped arrows (weakness/slowness/poison/harming), combat potions, hostiles |
| Apex | Top books, diamond, Mending, bosses |

import json
from pathlib import Path

j = json.loads(
    Path(
        r"D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Plugin Building\Minecraft\plugins\root-appreciation\src\main\resources\appreciation-rewards.json"

lines = [

    f"weight-sum: {j['weightSum']}",

    lines.append(f"  rank: {r['rank']}")

    lines.append(f"  weight: {r['weight']}")
    lines.append(f"  kind: {r['kind']}")

        lines.append(f"  material: {r['material']}")
    if "enchant" in r:
        lines.append(f"  enchant: {r['enchant']}")
    if "potion" in r:
        lines.append(f"  potion: {r['potion']}")
out = Path(
    r"D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Plugin Building\Minecraft\plugins\root-appreciation\src\main\resources\appreciation-rewards.yml"
)

R RootMC SMP

Home / Appreciation

Appreciation Tokens

Sunflower tokens you earn from votes and /bonus. Right-click one to redeem a single weighted reward — weak prizes are common, Nether Stars are rare. Every redeem is announced server-wide.

Right-click redeem 247 rewards Global announcement

On this page

  • Redeem tutorial
  • How to earn
  • Daily /bonus
  • Odds table
  • /thanks stats
  • FAQ

Related

  • Economy guide
  • Vote sites
  • Plugin install

Redeem tutorial

  1. Hold an Appreciation Token (sunflower) in your main hand.
  2. Make sure you have at least one empty inventory slot. Hotbar, backpack, or offhand / shield slot all count.
  3. Right-click (air or block). The server spends 1 token and rolls 1 reward from the catalog.
  4. You get a personal win message, and the whole server sees: who redeemed and what they won.
  5. Optional: /thanks redeem (or /thanks redeem 3 to roll three times if you have space and tokens).

Free Lotto Ticket wins grant a Root-Gamble /lotto free-play credit (same as your first unused free ticket) — not a numbered slip.

How to earn

  • Voting — each confirmed vote grants tokens (see vote sites).
  • /bonus — daily streak (tokens + Gold from the Server Reserve).
  • Staff events / memberships may also issue tokens.

Tokens are inventory items with tracking lore. Keep them safe — they are ledgered when issued and redeemed.

Daily /bonus

DayTokensGold
115 G
2210 G
3315 G
4420 G
5+525 G
  • ~20 hours between claims.
  • Miss ~48 hours → streak resets to Day 1.
  • Bonus Gold comes from the Server Reserve (not minted).

Odds table

Every redeem picks exactly one entry. Weights follow power rank: weaker items are more common; apex prizes (Mending, Warden egg, Nether Star, …) are rare.

Loading catalog…

/thanks stats

/thanks (aliases /appreciation, /apptoken) shows global and personal issued / redeemed totals, circulating supply, and your next /bonus hint.

FAQ

Why was my redeem blocked?

You need one empty slot (including offhand). Armor slots do not count. Clear a backpack or offhand slot and try again.

Do old tokens still work?

Yes — PDC marks the item. Lore refreshes on join after the redeem update.

Where does bonus Gold come from?

The Server Reserve — see the economy guide.

input.contents:
# rootmc-sexi (foundation)

Local background helper for **Sexi** — Discord design recommendations for RootMC proposals / staff chat.

## Goals (v0)

- Run on the operator workstation (not production Paper).
- Respond when someone says **Sexi** / **@sexi** / mentions the RootMC bot in watched channels.
- Answer with **game-design recommendations only** — no deploy steps, secrets, DB, jars, or internal paths.
- Never ping users on the deny list (opt-out).

## Run

```bat
cd "Web Files\rootmc-sexi"
npm start
```

Env (from workspace `.env` via existing RootMC loader):

- `DISCORD_ROOTMC_BOT_TOKEN` — read/reply
- `GROK_API_BEARER_TOKEN` or `GROK_ROOT_ASK_BEARER_TOKEN` — optional LLM; falls back to heuristic replies

HTTP:

- `GET http://127.0.0.1:8787/health`
- `POST http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/recommend` `{ "question": "...", "context": "..." }`

## Status

Foundation only. Gateway intents / slash command `@sexi` / Cursor SDK wiring come later.

# Proposal: Sexi Discord recommendation assistant

**Status:** foundation scaffolding — local workstation service. Not production Paper.

## Goal

Let staff (and later players in proposal threads) talk to **Sexi** for **direct design recommendations** without waiting for Alex to relay Cursor chat.

Trigger ideas: `Sexi`, `@sexi`, or bot mention in watched channels (proposals, admins, updates — configurable).

## Principles

1. **Recommendations only in public Discord** — no secrets, deploy steps, DB hosts, jar versions, or internal file paths.
2. **Opt-out pings** — never mention users who ask not to be tagged.
3. **Local-first** — runs on the operator machine in the background; later can move behind `api.rootmc.net` if we want.
4. **Optional LLM** — Grok (or later Cursor SDK) when keys exist; otherwise short heuristic replies so the loop still works.

## v0 delivered (this PR / folder)

`Web Files/rootmc-sexi/`:

- HTTP health + `/v1/recommend`
- Channel poller for Sexi / bot mentions → reply in-thread
- Deny-list for mentions
- Proposal poster script

## Next phases (not building yet unless approved)

1. Discord Gateway (lower latency than poll) + Message Content intent
2. Slash command `/sexi` or custom `@Sexi` webhook role
3. Cursor SDK `Agent.prompt` for repo-aware answers (still scrubbed for public chat)
4. Per-channel allowlist + rate limits
5. Optional Cloudflare Worker proxy with staff-only auth

## Success criteria

- `npm start` stays up locally
- Asking “Sexi, thoughts on X?” in a watched channel gets a useful design reply
- No secret leakage in Discord replies

Yes — **what’s built today is a local poller on your PC**, not something running on Shockbyte or Cloudflare.

### What “Sexi” is right now
A small Node app in `Web Files/rootmc-sexi`. When you run `npm start`, it starts two things on your machine:

1. **Local HTTP** on `127.0.0.1:8787` (health + `/v1/recommend`)
2. **Discord poller** — every ~12 seconds it reads recent messages in watched channels (proposals forum threads, etc.)

If someone says **Sexi / @sexi / bot mention**, it drafts a **design recommendation** and replies in Discord with the RootMC bot. Public replies stay scrubbed (no secrets/deploy paths).

If that process isn’t running on your PC, Sexi is offline. Nothing in the cloud is polling for it yet.

### How that differs from “auto governance”
Two layers people mix up:

| Piece | What it does | Where it runs |
|---|---|---|
| **Sexi (now)** | Chat recommendations in Discord | Your device poller |
| **Cursor / you** | Actual builds, deploys, config changes | You (or this chat) |
| **75% governance (discussed, not fully built)** | Later idea: majority vote → auto-edit proposals | Not a live executor yet |

So: Sexi can **talk**. It does **not** auto-ship jars, edit live servers, or govern without you. The “only Alex executes / don’t implement without majority” rule is policy around that — not an automatic vote→deploy engine.

### Simple picture
Discord message → your PC poller notices it → optional Grok/heuristic answer → bot reply.  
Your PC off / `npm start` not running → no Sexi.

# rootmc-sexi (foundation)

Local background helper for **Sexi** — Discord design recommendations for RootMC proposals / staff chat.

## Goals (v0)

- Run on the operator workstation (not production Paper).
- Respond when someone says **Sexi** / **@sexi** / mentions the RootMC bot in watched channels.
- Brain: **Cursor SDK** local agent on the RootMC workspace (repo-aware).
- Answer with **game-design recommendations only** — no deploy steps, secrets, DB, jars, or internal paths.
- Never ping users on the deny list (opt-out).

## Run

```bat
cd "Web Files\rootmc-sexi"
npm start
```

Env (from workspace `.env` via existing RootMC loader):

- `DISCORD_ROOTMC_BOT_TOKEN` — read/reply
- `CURSOR_API_KEY` — **required** for Cursor brain ([Dashboard → Integrations](https://cursor.com/dashboard/integrations))
- `SEXI_MODEL` — optional, default `composer-2.5`
- `SEXI_WORKSPACE` — optional cwd override (default: RootMC workspace root)
- `SEXI_USE_GROK=1` — opt-in Grok only if Cursor fails (not preferred)

Without `CURSOR_API_KEY`, Sexi falls back to short local heuristics.

HTTP:

- `GET http://127.0.0.1:8787/health`
- `POST http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/recommend` `{ "question": "...", "context": "..." }`

## Flow

Discord trigger → poller on this PC → `Agent.prompt` (local, RootMC `cwd`) → scrub → bot reply.

Cursor runs are serialised (one at a time). Prompt forbids edits/deploys; sandbox + auto-review when supported.

Cursor brain wired. Gateway intents / slash `/sexi` still later.

/** Strip skin-tone modifiers + variation selectors for lookup. */
export function normalizeEmojiKey(raw) {
  return String(raw || "")
    .trim()
    .replace(/[\u{1F3FB}-\u{1F3FF}]/gu, "")
    .replace(/\uFE0F/g, "");
}

export function lookupStandardSignal(emoji) {
  const raw = String(emoji || "").trim();
  if (!raw) return null;
  if (STANDARD_EMOJI_SIGNALS[raw]) return STANDARD_EMOJI_SIGNALS[raw];
  const norm = normalizeEmojiKey(raw);
  if (STANDARD_EMOJI_SIGNALS[norm]) return STANDARD_EMOJI_SIGNALS[norm];
  // try with VS16 re-added for some keys
  if (STANDARD_EMOJI_SIGNALS[`${norm}\uFE0F`]) return STANDARD_EMOJI_SIGNALS[`${norm}\uFE0F`];
  return null;
}

Tracing the live Ava → Cursor path so the explanation matches what’s running now.

Here’s how it works **right now** on this box.

## What is running

`npm start` in `Web Files/rootmc-ava` launches two Node processes:

1. **`server.mjs`** — status page at http://127.0.0.1:8787/
2. **`poller.mjs`** — Discord + brain (this is Ava)

Secrets come from RootMC `.env` (`AVA_DISCORD_*`, `CURSOR_API_KEY`).

## Discord → Ava

Transport is **`both`**:

- **Gateway** (WebSocket) for live messages / DMs  
- **REST poller** as backup / boot catch-up  

When someone pings her (mention, name, reply, or DM), `pipeline.mjs`:

1. Saves attachments → `Server Handoffs/Ava Ivy/uploads/`
2. Packs context (persona, lead-dev notes, people, wiki/local packs, profiles)
3. Calls `recommend()` → `cursorRecommend()`
4. Posts the reply back to Discord

## Where Cursor builds / digs

Cursor is **local on this machine**, not a cloud agent VM.

```124:129:Web Files/rootmc-ava/src/cursorBrain.mjs
      local: {
        cwd,
        settingSources: [],
        autoReview: true,
        ...(withSandbox ? { sandboxOptions: { enabled: true } } : {}),
      },
```

- **SDK:** `@cursor/sdk` (`Agent.prompt` or `Agent.create` + `send` for images)
- **Auth:** `CURSOR_API_KEY` from `.env`
- **Model:** `composer-2.5` (unless `AVA_MODEL` overrides)
- **Working directory (`cwd`):** RootMC workspace root  
  `D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\`  
  (or `AVA_WORKSPACE` if set)

So when she “digs,” Cursor’s agent runs **against the whole RootMC tree** on disk — plugins, web, handoffs, etc. — with Ava’s prompt + packs glued on. Handoff drop zone is `Server Handoffs/Ava Ivy/` (`uploads/`, `plans/`, `data/`).

Digs are **queued one-at-a-time** in `cursorBrain.mjs`, with a timeout (~75s text / ~120s images) so she doesn’t hang forever.

## What she is *not* doing

- Not Grok / xAI (unplugged)
- Not auto-deploying to Shockbyte / FileZilla
- Not supposed to silently restart servers — digs describe / stage; you execute live deploys

## Mental picture

```
Discord ──gateway/poller──► rootmc-ava (this PC)
                               │
                               ├─ packs + uploads/
                               ▼
                         @cursor/sdk local agent
                         cwd = RootMC workspace
                         model = composer-2.5
                               │
                               ▼
                         Discord reply (scrubbed)
```

Status window is just a local dashboard of that process — not where building happens.

**Before:** digs were **1-at-a-time**, and every restart opened another status window — so the dashboard looked “hot” while Discord felt stuck, and you got a pile of windows.

- Status shows **Agents `N/3`** (+ waiting count)
- Restarts **don’t open a new window** — refresh one existing http://127.0.0.1:8787/ tab (force a new one with `AVA_STATUS_WINDOW=force`)

Close the extra Edge/Chrome status apps; keep one and refresh it.

def write_skill(
    sid,
    display,
    icon,
    talents_list,
    block=None,
    default_block=5,
    combat_hit=1,
    combat_kill=10,
    action=5,
):
    lines = [
        f"id: {sid}",
        f"display-name: {display}",
        "enabled: true",
        "max-level: 1000",
        f"icon: {icon}",
        "xp-sources:",
    ]
    if block:
        lines.append("  block-break:")
        for k, v in block.items():
            lines.append(f"    {k}: {v}")
    lines.append(f"  default-block: {default_block}")
    lines.append(f"  combat-hit: {combat_hit}")
    lines.append(f"  combat-kill: {combat_kill}")
    lines.append(f"  action: {action}")
    lines.append("talents:")
    for t in talents_list:
        lines.append(f"  - {t}")
    (skills / f"{sid}.yml").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def write_talent(
    tid,
    dname,
    desc,
    skill_id,
    unlock,
    maxr,
    mana,
    cd,
    dur,
    triggers,
    effects,
    conds,
):
    lines = [
        f"id: {tid}",
        f"display-name: {dname}",
        f"description: {desc}",
        f"skill: {skill_id}",
        f"unlock-level: {unlock}",
        f"max-rank: {maxr}",
        f"mana-cost: {mana}",
        f"cooldown-seconds: {cd}",
        f"duration-seconds: {dur}",
        "triggers:",
    ]
    for t in triggers:
        lines.append(f"  - {t}")
    lines.append("effects:")
    for e in effects:
        lines.append(f"  - id: {e['id']}")
        for k, v in e.items():
            if k == "id":
                continue
            if isinstance(v, str) and ("&" in v or "!" in v or " " in v):
                lines.append(f"    {k}: '{v}'")
            else:
                lines.append(f"    {k}: {v}")
    if not conds:
        lines.append("conditions: []")
    else:
        lines.append("conditions:")
        for c in conds:
            lines.append(f"  - type: {c['type']}")
            lines.append(f"    value: {c['value']}")
    (talents / f"{tid}.yml").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

input.plan:
# Channel catch-up, unpause, fix/deploy, #updates post

## Goal

Bring Ava back to active ops: full channel read, clear idle/pause layers we control, continue implementable work, stage/ship what this workstation can deploy, then **post a finished summary to Discord `#updates` (`1520665313631408251`)**.

## Current reality (do not ignore)

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  read[Read all watched channels plus updates]
  unpause[Clear hush / wake break]
  fix[Fix implementable bugs and staged gaps]
  deploy[Deploy Ava API web / stage jars]
  votes[Four jobs stay blocked on votes]
  post[Ava posts summary to updates]
  read --> unpause --> fix --> deploy --> votes --> post
```

- Ava is **not** QUIET (`hush.json` muted false) and **not** emergency-stopped.
- Heartbeat often shows **onBreak** (idle) — wake/resume polling; that is the main “unpause.”
- **4 jobs blocked on votes** (cannot implement until pass): boats `job-ms9p5x2i`, Slack-dev `job-ms9qhtmc`, DB-nodes `job-ms9qv1q2`, hourly snapshots `job-ms9s7pa0`.
- Staged jars (Claims/Towny/Test) already include Core `1.7.6`, Skills `1.0.1`, etc. — **FileZilla + Shockbyte stay human**.

## Scope defaults (locked)

| Surface | Action |
|---|---|
| Discord read | All 9 watch channels + `#updates` + open proposal threads |
| Discord write during work | Reply only where needed to unblock / answer open asks; no spam |
| End state | **One catch-up post from Ava to `1520665313631408251`** |
| Ava local | Silent restart if code changed (`AVA_NO_STATUS_WINDOW=1`) |
| API / web | Deploy only if fixes touch [`Web Files/rootmc-api`](Web Files/rootmc-api) or [`Web Files/rootmc-web`](Web Files/rootmc-web) |
| Plugins | Re-verify handoff staging; **do not** claim live until you upload/restart |
| Vote-gated features | Report status; **do not** implement boats / Slack-dev / DB-nodes / snapshot gate |

## Phase 1 — Read every channel

Using Ava Discord token + guild APIs (or existing scan scripts under [`Web Files/rootmc-ava/scripts`](Web Files/rootmc-ava/scripts)):

1. Pull recent messages from each watched ID in [`config.mjs`](Web Files/rootmc-ava/src/config.mjs): proposals, admins, general, governance, voting, constitution, memes, ava-ivy, development — **and** `#updates` `1520665313631408251`.
2. Include open proposal forum threads referenced by the 4 jobs.
3. Produce an internal triage list: unanswered @Ava, operator asks, vote status, bugs vs features.

## Phase 2 — Unpause developments

1. Confirm hush off; clear emergency stop if somehow present.
2. Wake Ava from break (gateway/poller hot path; ensure `onBreak` clears and watch loop is live).
3. Ensure `#updates` is either already watched or temporarily included for the final post (post via bot API even if not on default watch list).
4. Do **not** flip vote-blocked jobs to `open` without a real vote pass — that would violate governance.

## Phase 3 — Fix and continue what is not vote-gated

Prioritize from triage + known backlog:

- Ava runtime/config fixes discovered in channel asks (cooldown already 40s).
- Root-Discord → Root-Core already staged; confirm handoffs have no leftover `root-discord` jar.
- Root-Skills cutover: document Test-first path only; no live mcMMO removal without your explicit cutover.
- Any clear **bugs** that can stage without a proposal; features stay gated.

## Phase 4 — Deploy (workstation-capable)

1. **Ava:** apply code fixes → silent local restart → `GET http://127.0.0.1:8787/health`.
2. **API:** if realm-api changes: `powershell -File "Web Files\rootmc-api\deploy.ps1"`.
3. **Web:** if site changes: `cd Web Files\rootmc-web` → `deploy.ps1`.
4. **Plugins:** only if rebuild needed: `Plugin Building\Minecraft\build-with-server-jdk.bat publishPlugins` then sync jars into the three handoff `plugins\` folders. You still FileZilla + Shockbyte.

## Phase 5 — Final Ava post to `#updates`

When phases 1–4 are done, have Ava post **one** message to `1520665313631408251` covering:

- Channels scanned / open asks handled
- Unpaused (not QUIET; live again)
- What shipped or staged locally
- What remains human: FileZilla/Shockbyte, skills cutover, Discord rename/Members Intent
- Vote-blocked jobs still waiting (list the 4)
- Pointer to `#development` / proposals as needed

Prefer a small script (extend pattern from [`catchup-snappy.mjs`](Web Files/rootmc-ava/scripts/catchup-snappy.mjs) / [`full-update-post.mjs`](Web Files/rootmc-ava/scripts/full-update-post.mjs)) posting as Ava, not a raw webhook, so authorship matches the bot.

## Explicit non-goals

- No mass Discord spam / no @everyone unless you ask mid-run
- No force-passing governance votes
- No Shockbyte restart or FileZilla from the agent
- No live mcMMO removal in this pass

input.plan:
# Physical Vote Tokens + EC-only Bonds

## Locked decisions

**Vote Tokens (formula):** Listing votes mint **1 physical Vote Token** each (Appreciation-style item + pending/backfill). Governance becomes:

`raw = playtime_seconds × ec_vote_token_count × pro_multiplier`

- Tokens **not** in `/ec` contribute **0** (no baseline-1 while EC is empty).
- Ava’s synthetic 10% seat stays API-side (no physical tokens required).
- Historical listing votes **backfill** pending Vote Tokens (same pattern as Appreciation vote grants).

**Bonds:** Already physical paper. Change activity rules to:

- Earn coupons **only** if that note’s item is in the holder’s `/ec`
- Outside `/ec` → **no earnings** and **deregister** from active/registered bond supply (DB owner cleared or marked inactive until re-registered from EC)
- **Redeem** and **merge** only when the note(s) are in `/ec` (reject inventory-only)

Town/nation auto-bonds stay virtual (no paper) and keep current gov bank rules.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  subgraph mint [Mint]
    Vote[Listing vote] --> VT[Vote Token item]
    Buy[Bond purchase] --> Note[Bond certificate]
  end
  subgraph ec [Ender chest only]
    VT --> ActiveVote[Active vote_points]
    Note --> ActiveBond[Registered supply plus earnings]
  end
  subgraph outside [Outside EC]
    VT2[Token in inv] --> ZeroVote[0 vote weight]
    Note2[Note in inv] --> Inactive[Deregistered no earnings no redeem merge]
  end
```

## 1. Vote Token item + grants (plugin)

Add alongside Appreciation in [root-appreciation](Plugin Building/Minecraft/plugins/root-appreciation/) **or** a thin helper inside RootMC/Root-Play — prefer **Root-Appreciation** host for item/PDC/pending delivery reuse:

- New item: distinct from sunflower Appreciation (e.g. `PAPER` / `NAME_TAG`), PDC `vote_share_token` (+ issue id)
- `VoteShareTokenItem` + grant/pending tables (or reuse pending with `kind=vote_share`)
- On verified listing vote: mint **1 Vote Token** (keep Appreciation grant as-is unless you say otherwise)
- Soft SPI from [VoteRewardService](Plugin Building/Minecraft/plugins/root-play/) / Root-Play reflection (mirror `grantVoteTokens` appreciation path)
- Chest-shop key in `ShopItemKeys` so tokens trade in shops
- Scan helper: count tokens in `player.getEnderChest()` only

## 2. Governance math (plugin + API)

**Plugin:** [LocalGovernancePowerService.java](Plugin Building/Minecraft/plugins/rootmc/src/main/java/com/rootrecord/minecraft/rootstat/governance/LocalGovernancePowerService.java) — `votePoints` = online EC token count for that UUID (0 if offline/empty). Cache refresh on join + ender-chest inventory close/click.

**API:** [rootmc-governance-voting.ts](Web Files/rootmc-realm-api/src/rootmc-governance-voting.ts) — replace Votifier-derived `vote_points` with server-reported `ec_vote_token_count` from economy/heartbeat sync (extend existing heartbeat payload used by [EconomyHeartbeatService](Plugin Building/Minecraft/plugins/root-economy/src/main/java/com/rootrecord/minecraft/rootessentials/service/EconomyHeartbeatService.java) / RootStat). Stale/missing sync → 0 tokens (no silent fallback to old listing totals for weight).

**Docs:** constitution + council copy: vote points = Vote Tokens in `/ec`; listing votes mint tokens; tradeable; only EC counts.

## 3. Bonds: EC-only supply, earnings, redeem, merge

Live code in **Root-Economy** bonds package ([root-economy/.../rootbonds](Plugin Building/Minecraft/plugins/root-economy/src/main/java/com/rootrecord/minecraft/rootbonds/)):

| Change | Where |
|---|---|
| Register **only** from `getEnderChest()` | [BondOwnershipListener](Plugin Building/Minecraft/plugins/root-economy/src/main/java/com/rootrecord/minecraft/rootbonds/gui/BondOwnershipListener.java) — stop scanning main inventory; on move-out of EC, **unregister** that `bond_id` from ledger ownership / active supply |
| Active principal = EC-registered only | [BondPrincipalResolver](Plugin Building/Minecraft/plugins/root-economy/src/main/java/com/rootrecord/minecraft/rootbonds/service/BondPrincipalResolver.java) + income tick — skip bonds not EC-registered |
| Redeem only if note in EC | [BondService.redeemBondDetail](Plugin Building/Minecraft/plugins/root-economy/src/main/java/com/rootrecord/minecraft/rootbonds/service/BondService.java) — require matching certificate in ender chest |
| Merge only EC notes | `mergeInventoryBonds` → merge **ender-chest** redeemable notes only; place merged cert back in EC |
| UX copy | Bonds tip / `/bonds` lore: keep notes in `/ec` or they stop earning and leave supply |

Cloud sync ([BondCloudSync](Plugin Building/Minecraft/plugins/root-economy/)) continues after EC register/unregister so D1 `rootmc_bonds` matches active supply.

Offline: no Paper NBT reader in v1 — last EC registration snapshot stands until next online refresh (same online-centric pattern as current ownership listener).

## 4. Ship surface

- Bump Root-Appreciation (or host), Root-Economy, RootMC/Root-Play as needed; `publishPlugins` → stage Claims + Towny handoffs
- Deploy `rootmc-api` + `rootmc-web` for formula/docs
- No Discord posts unless you ask

## Out of scope (this pass)

- Removing Riphamsty / ban→weight transfer automation
- Changing Ava’s 10% seat math
- Offline EC NBT scanning
- Replacing Appreciation Tokens

# Physical Vote Shards + EC-only Bonds

## Locked decisions

**Vote Shards (mimic Appreciation, do not replace it):** Listing votes still grant Appreciation Tokens as today. **Additionally**, each verified listing vote mints **1 physical Vote Shard** (same grant/pending/backfill pattern as Appreciation — separate item, separate PDC).

Material: **`AMETHYST_SHARD`** (crystal shards). Display name **Vote Shard**. PDC e.g. `vote_shard` (+ issue id) so plain amethyst never counts.

Governance formula:

`raw = playtime_seconds × ec_vote_shard_count × pro_multiplier`

- **Only shards currently inside the holder’s `/ec` qualify to vote.** Carrying, moving, trading, or parking them in inventory / hotbar / shulkers / chests elsewhere = **not eligible** (0 weight from those shards).
- Empty `/ec` → 0 shard points (no baseline-1).
- Refresh weight on join and whenever `/ec` contents change; removing shards from `/ec` immediately drops vote power.
- Ava’s synthetic 10% seat stays API-side (no physical shards required).
- Historical listing votes **backfill** pending Vote Shards (Appreciation vote grants stay unchanged).

**Bonds:** Already physical paper. Change activity rules to:

- Earn coupons **only** if that note’s item is in the holder’s `/ec`
- Outside `/ec` → **no earnings** and **deregister** from active/registered bond supply
- **Redeem** and **merge** only when the note(s) are in `/ec`

Town/nation auto-bonds stay virtual (no paper).

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  subgraph mint [Mint]
    Vote[Listing vote] --> Apprec[Appreciation Token unchanged]
    Vote --> VS[Vote Shard amethyst]
    Buy[Bond purchase] --> Note[Bond certificate]
  end
  subgraph ec [Ender chest only]
    VS --> ActiveVote[Active vote_points]
    Note --> ActiveBond[Registered supply plus earnings]
  end
  subgraph outside [Outside EC]
    VS2[Shard moving or in inv] --> ZeroVote[Does not qualify to vote]
    Note2[Note in inv] --> Inactive[Deregistered no earnings no redeem merge]
  end
```

## 1. Vote Shard item + grants (plugin)

**Mimic** Appreciation in [root-appreciation](Plugin Building/Minecraft/plugins/root-appreciation/) — parallel classes, **do not** alter sunflower Appreciation redeem/grant behavior:

- `VoteShardItem` — material `AMETHYST_SHARD`, name **Vote Shard**, lore that only `/ec` holdings count toward Council weight
- PDC `vote_shard` (+ issue id); pending delivery table/kind separate from Appreciation

- **Server-isolated:** Claims and Towny each store their own 54-slot EC data (MySQL keyed by `server_id` + `uuid`, or per-host DB). Contents do **not** sync across hosts.
- Migrate: on first open after upgrade, copy vanilla ender contents into the new 54-slot inv (slots 0–26), leave 27–53 empty; then prefer the custom inv for all RootMC scans (bonds, vote shards, gold census hooks that today call `getEnderChest()`).
- Block vanilla ender-chest block opens into the same custom inv (or redirect) so `/ec` and the block stay consistent on that server.

### Vote Shards (mimic Appreciation — do not replace it)

Listing votes still grant Appreciation Tokens. **Additionally**, each verified listing vote on **that server** mints **+1 Vote Shard weight** owed on **that server only**.

### Condensation ladder (merge in `/ec` only)

| Tier | Name | Material | How you get it |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Vote Shard** | `AMETHYST_SHARD` | Minted per listing vote (weight 1) |
| 2 | **Vote Shard Block** | `AMETHYST_BLOCK` | Merge shards in `/ec` → summed weight |
| 3 | **Vote Geode** | `BUDDING_AMETHYST` | Merge blocks in `/ec` → summed weight |

**Lore:** every stack shows **that stack’s voting power**. Plain amethyst never counts.

**Two-step merge in `/ec` only** (inventory merge rejected). Geode+geode → one geode. No split in v1.

### Per-server exact owed deposit

On each host (Claims, Towny) **independently**:

1. Compute **owed weight** = that server’s all-time verified listing vote count for the player (local `rewards_votes` / same source as today’s local vote points) minus weight already present as Vote Shard items in **that server’s** double `/ec` (and any pending queue for that server).
2. Deposit the **exact owed amount** into their custom `/ec` as **maximally condensed** items (prefer one **Vote Geode** with weight = owed; if merge ladder requires intermediate forms for UX, still net exact total weight — no more, no less).
3. Run on join / first enable after upgrade (idempotent). New votes grant +1 into `/ec` or pending-if-full on **that server only**.
4. Trading a shard to another player on Claims does **not** move Towny weight (separate EC + separate owed ledgers).

### Governance formula

`raw = ec_vote_shard_count × pro_multiplier`  
`share = raw ÷ Σ raw → %`

- `ec_vote_shard_count` = Σ weights in **that context’s** double `/ec` (API aggregate: sum or per-`server_id` as today for multi-host — heartbeat reports per server; cloud snapshot uses synced EC counts, **not** playtime, **not** cross-server EC merge).
- No playtime multiplier. Outside `/ec` → does not qualify. Linked + terms to cast. Ava 10% seat unchanged (API synthetic).

### Bonds

Earn / registered supply / redeem / merge **only** when the note is in the **custom double `/ec`**. Outside → no earnings + deregister. Town/nation auto-bonds stay virtual.

# ROOTATMUS_PRIME → Headless Ubuntu Server (SSH) — Full Migration Plan

**Author:** Ava Ivy (for Alexrs94)  
**Updated:** 2026-08-01 (HST) — v2 after thread decision  
**Thread:** https://discord.com/channels/1516108585740800042/1533183979778478241  
**Target:** `ROOTATMUS_PRIME` — Dell OptiPlex 7060 · **i5-8500T** · **32 GB RAM**  

---

## Status (operator intent — locked from Discord)

| Decision | Choice |
|----------|--------|
| Wipe / format whole SSD? | **No** |
| Keep Windows? | **Yes** (stay bootable) |
| Preferred layout | **Safer path:** copy current **SSD → D:** first, then carve a **~50% new partition on D:** for Ubuntu |
| Dual-boot | Yes — Windows remains; Ubuntu is additive |
| Access goal | Headless **Ubuntu Server** + **SSH** (key auth) |
| Operator next step | **Boot USB with Ubuntu** (in progress) |
| Laptop | Stays Alex’s play / day machine; OptiPlex becomes Ava’s brain box |

Thread quotes that drive this revision:
- *“make my server a server again”* / *“Energy… 3x better”*
- *“I don't want to entirely format partition, keep 50/50 windows, better yet, safer option would be to create a new 50% partition on drive D:/ and copy everything from current SSD FIRST”*

**Plan default is no longer “clean wipe SSD.”** That is Option Z (last resort only).

---

## 0. Why we’re doing this

1. Ava asked to live on the OptiPlex so the laptop isn’t fighting solar + Cursor + digs.
2. Melee: she needs space; better for both of you.
3. Goal: stable headless Linux ops for RootMC + Ava (`rootmc-ava`), same 32 GB chassis.

---

## 1. Hardware truth (old project refs)

**Primary:** `D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Change Logs\Dev Device Root Report 07-25-2026.txt`  
**Companion:** `Change Logs\Pre-Run Report Local Testing 07-25-2026.txt` (Desktop SSD I/O lesson)

| Item | Value |
|------|--------|
| Hostname (Windows) | `ROOTATMUS_PRIME` |
| Model | Dell OptiPlex 7060 |
| CPU | i5-8500T · 6C/6T · 35 W |
| RAM | **32 GB** DDR4 |
| NIC | Intel I219-LM 1 Gbps · MAC `54-BF-64-89-25-0B` |
| Disk A (SSD) | LITEON **~128 GB** — Windows `C:` (historically very full ~94%) |
| Disk B (HDD) | HGST **~931 GB** — Windows `D:` Work Station (~755 GB free at July scan) |

**Critical layout note:** `C:` and `D:` are **two physical disks**.  
That makes the safer plan even safer: **leave the entire SSD as Windows**; put Ubuntu on a **new partition of the HDD (D:)** after copying the SSD image/tree onto D: first.

Old lesson to keep: hot paths like SSD; bulk/backup on HDD — but for *this* cutover, Ubuntu on D: is an acceptable trade for **not touching Windows boot**. Later you can migrate Ava’s hot paths to a larger SSD if you add one.

---

## 2. Goal state (v2)

| Layer | Target |
|-------|--------|
| Windows | Untouched boot on **SSD** (or shrunk only if you later choose true 50/50 on C:) |
| Ubuntu | **24.04 LTS Server**, headless, on **new ~50% partition of D:/HDD** |
| Boot | GRUB or firmware boot menu — **Windows stays default** until SSH proven |
| SSH | OpenSSH, key-only after smoke test |
| Hostname (Linux) | `rootatmus-prime` |
| Workspace | Eventually `/srv/rootmc` on Ubuntu partition; HDD remainder stays `/data` or NTFS share |
| Ava | systemd `ava-ivy` · single process stack · tunnel `:8787` from laptop |
| Secrets | Never in git; copy `.env` via encrypted USB / scp after SSH works |

---

## 3. Strategy ladder (pick in order)

### ★ Option S — **Selected: SSD copy → new ~50% partition on D: → Ubuntu there**
1. Copy **everything from current SSD** onto D: (mirror / image / robocopy).
2. Free or carve **~50% of D:** into a new partition (ext4 for Ubuntu).
3. Install Ubuntu Server **only** onto that new partition (USB installer “Something else”).
4. Install GRUB carefully; keep Windows bootloader recoverable.
5. SSH harden; rsync live RootMC; run Ava; stop Windows Ava.

### Option T — True 50/50 on the SSD (only if D: plan fails space-wise)
- Shrink Windows on C:, new ext4 half on SSD.
- Faster I/O for Ava, but **higher risk** to Windows boot — do **after** SSD→D: copy exists.

### Option Z — Full wipe SSD (not selected)
- Fastest “server again,” highest regret surface. Skip unless backups are bulletproof and you explicitly change your mind.

---

## 4. Phase 0 — Ubuntu boot USB (you’re doing this now)

**ISO:** Ubuntu Server **24.04.x LTS** (not Desktop).  
**Flash:** Rufus (DD mode) or balenaEtcher on a ≥8 GB USB.  
**OptiPlex BIOS:** Boot Menu (F12) → USB; confirm AHCI; try Secure Boot **on** first.

**Installer mindset for Option S:**
- When you reach storage: choose **Something else / manual**.
- Select **only the new empty partition on the HDD**.
- **Do not** format `C:` / the Windows SSD.
- **Do not** format the NTFS remainder of D: that still holds the SSD copy / RootMC tree until you’ve verified the copy.
- Bootloader device: typically the disk that should own GRUB — prefer installing GRUB to the **HDD** if Windows SSD EFI can stay primary; if the machine only has one EFI system partition on the SSD, installer may want to use that ESP — **photograph every screen** and keep a Windows recovery USB handy.

**Before you reboot into the installer for real:** finish Phase 1 copy (below) so a failed install never orphans the only copy of the SSD.

---

## 5. Phase 1 — Copy current SSD → D: FIRST (mandatory)

Do this **from running Windows**, before resizing D:.

### 5.1 Free space check on D:
July scan: ~**755 GB free** on ~931 GB HDD.  
128 GB SSD fit easily for a full mirror **if D: still has ≥150–200 GB free** after RootMC. Re-check:

```powershell
Get-PSDrive C,D | Format-Table Name,Used,Free
Get-Disk | Format-Table Number,FriendlyName,Size,PartitionStyle
Get-Partition | Format-Table DiskNumber,DriveLetter,Size,Type
```

### 5.2 What “copy everything from SSD” means

Pick **one** (A is easiest; B is truest disaster recovery):

**A) File-level mirror (recommended first pass)**  
Staging folder example: `D:\SSD-MIRROR-ROOTATMUS-2026-08-01\`

```powershell
# Run elevated. Adjust letters if needed.
$src = "C:\"
$dst = "D:\SSD-MIRROR-ROOTATMUS-2026-08-01\"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dst | Out-Null
robocopy $src $dst /MIR /MIR /XJ /R:2 /W:5 /MT:8 `
  /XD "$src` `$Recycle.Bin" "$src`System Volume Information" "$src`Windows\Temp" `
  /LOG:"D:\SSD-MIRROR-ROOTATMUS-2026-08-01-robocopy.log"
```

Also explicitly verify these exist on D: (canonical live tree may already be on D: — still mirror C: system + whatever still lives on SSD):

- `D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\` (already on D: — still back up `.env` / Ava data)
- Desktop items you care about if they live on `C:\Users\store\Desktop`
- Ava data: `...\Server Handoffs\Ava Ivy\data\`
- Secrets: RootMC `.env` → **encrypted USB**, not plain D: if the box is shared

**B) Block-level image of the 128 GB SSD** (best rollback)  
Macrium Reflect / similar → image entire SSD to `D:\Images\` or external.  
Allows restoring Windows if GRUB ever eats the boot path.

### 5.3 Verify before partitioning
- Spot-check sizes vs source.
- Open a few critical files from the mirror.
- Confirm `.env` / Ava `data` / plugin source readable.
- Write a one-line `VERIFY-OK.txt` with timestamp in the mirror folder.

**Do not shrink/create partitions on D: until VERIFY-OK exists.**

---

## 6. Phase 2 — Create ~50% new partition on D:

Still in Windows (Disk Management or `diskpart`).

### 6.1 Conceptual math
- HDD ~931 GB.
- Target: **~400–465 GB** new partition for Ubuntu (≈ half), remainder stays NTFS for mirrors + RootMC bulk.
- Exact “50%” is flexible — prioritize: enough for `/` + `/home` + `/srv` (suggest **≥80 GB** minimum; **200–400 GB** comfortable).

### 6.2 Steps (Disk Management)
1. Shrink the existing NTFS volume on D: by the size you want for Ubuntu **or** create from unallocated if already free.
2. Leave the new space as **Unallocated** (do **not** format NTFS for Ubuntu).
3. Note **disk number** of the HDD vs SSD (SSD = Windows; HDD = D:).

### 6.3 Safety rails
- Never shrink below what RootMC + SSD mirror need.
- If shrink is blocked by immovable files, defrag isn’t magic on modern NTFS — use a smaller Ubuntu slice or temporary external staging.

---

## 7. Phase 3 — Install Ubuntu from USB onto the new D: space only

1. Boot USB → Ubuntu Server 24.04.
2. Network: Ethernet DHCP OK; set reservation later.
3. Storage: **custom / something else**.
4. Create on the **unallocated HDD space only**:
   - `ext4` → mount `/` (main)
   - optional small `swap` (e.g. 8–16 GB) given 32 GB RAM — or skip swap if you prefer
   - optional `/boot` if installer asks
5. **Do not** select Windows SSD partitions for format.
6. User: `store` (or `avaops`) + enable **OpenSSH** in installer.
7. Reboot; use boot menu to confirm **Windows still boots** and **Ubuntu boots**.

### 7.1 First-boot Ubuntu commands
```bash
sudo apt update && sudo apt -y full-upgrade
sudo timedatectl set-timezone Pacific/Honolulu
hostnamectl
sudo hostnamectl set-hostname rootatmus-prime
```

---

## 8. Phase 4 — SSH from the laptop (day-one harden)

On OptiPlex Ubuntu:

input.command:
$script = @'
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing

$baselineE = 51761475584  # E: used when robocopy started (~48.2 GB)
$sourceTarget = 333675487232  # D: used at start (~310.8 GB)
$robocopyPid = 10480
$logPath = "E:\robocopy-D-to-E.log"

$form = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Form
$form.Text = "Robocopy D:\ → E:\ — progress"
$form.Size = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(720, 420)
$form.StartPosition = "CenterScreen"
$form.TopMost = $true
$form.BackColor = [System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(24, 26, 30)
$form.ForeColor = [System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(230, 232, 235)
$form.Font = New-Object System.Drawing.Font("Segoe UI", 10)

$title = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Label
$title.Text = "D:\ Work Station  →  E:\ Portable Archive"
$title.Location = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(20, 18)
$title.Size = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(660, 28)
$title.Font = New-Object System.Drawing.Font("Segoe UI Semibold", 13)
$form.Controls.Add($title)

$pctLabel = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Label
$pctLabel.Text = "…"
$pctLabel.Location = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(20, 55)
$pctLabel.Size = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(660, 24)
$pctLabel.Font = New-Object System.Drawing.Font("Segoe UI Semibold", 16)
$form.Controls.Add($pctLabel)

$bar = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.ProgressBar
$bar.Location = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(20, 90)
$bar.Size = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(660, 28)
$bar.Minimum = 0
$bar.Maximum = 1000
$form.Controls.Add($bar)

$stats = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Label
$stats.Location = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(20, 132)
$stats.Size = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(660, 90)
$stats.Font = New-Object System.Drawing.Font("Consolas", 10)
$form.Controls.Add($stats)

$latest = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Label
$latest.Location = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(20, 230)
$latest.Size = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(660, 100)
$latest.Font = New-Object System.Drawing.Font("Consolas", 9)
$form.Controls.Add($latest)

$status = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Label
$status.Location = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(20, 340)
$status.Size = New-Object System.Drawing.Size(660, 28)
$status.ForeColor = [System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(120, 200, 140)
$form.Controls.Add($status)

$startTick = [Environment]::TickCount64
$lastCopied = 0
$lastTick = $startTick

$timer = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Timer
$timer.Interval = 1500
$timer.Add_Tick({
  try {
    $alive = Get-Process -Id $robocopyPid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    # also match any robocopy D:\ E:\
    if (-not $alive) {
      $alive = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='robocopy.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'D:\\.*E:\\' } |
        Select-Object -First 1
      if ($alive) { $script:robocopyPid = $alive.ProcessId }
    }

    $e = Get-PSDrive E
    $d = Get-PSDrive D
    $copied = [Math]::Max(0, [int64]$e.Used - [int64]$baselineE)
    $pct = if ($sourceTarget -gt 0) { [Math]::Min(0.999, $copied / $sourceTarget) } else { 0 }
    $bar.Value = [int]($pct * 1000)
    $pctLabel.Text = ("{0:N1}%  ·  {1:N1} GB of ~{2:N1} GB" -f ($pct*100), ($copied/1GB), ($sourceTarget/1GB))

    $now = [Environment]::TickCount64
    $dt = [Math]::Max(0.5, ($now - $lastTick) / 1000.0)
    $rate = ($copied - $lastCopied) / $dt
    if ($rate -lt 0) { $rate = 0 }
    $script:lastCopied = $copied
    $script:lastTick = $now

    $elapsed = ($now - $startTick) / 1000.0
    $avgRate = if ($elapsed -gt 1) { $copied / $elapsed } else { $rate }
    $remain = [Math]::Max(0, $sourceTarget - $copied)
    $etaSec = if ($avgRate -gt 1MB) { $remain / $avgRate } else { -1 }
    $etaTxt = if ($etaSec -lt 0) { "…" } elseif ($etaSec -lt 3600) { "{0:N0} min" -f ($etaSec/60) } else { "{0:N1} hr" -f ($etaSec/3600) }

    $stats.Text = @(
      ("Copied (est): {0:N2} GB" -f ($copied/1GB))
      ("Speed now:    {0:N1} MB/s   ·  avg {1:N1} MB/s" -f ($rate/1MB), ($avgRate/1MB))
      ("ETA:          {0}" -f $etaTxt)
      ("D: used {0:N1} GB free {1:N1} GB  |  E: used {2:N1} GB free {3:N1} GB" -f ($d.Used/1GB), ($d.Free/1GB), ($e.Used/1GB), ($e.Free/1GB))
    ) -join "`r`n"

    $tail = ""
    if (Test-Path $logPath) {
      $lines = Get-Content $logPath -Tail 40 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      $fileLines = $lines | Where-Object { $_ -match '\\' -and $_ -notmatch 'EXTRA' } | Select-Object -Last 3
      if (-not $fileLines) { $fileLines = $lines | Select-Object -Last 3 }
      $tail = ($fileLines -join "`r`n")
      if ($tail.Length -gt 420) { $tail = "…" + $tail.Substring($tail.Length - 420) }
    }
    $latest.Text = "Log:`r`n" + $tail

    if ($alive) {
      $status.Text = "RUNNING  ·  robocopy pid $robocopyPid  ·  refresh 1.5s  ·  estimate from E: growth (extras on E: not deleted)"
      $status.ForeColor = [System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(120, 200, 140)
    } else {
      $status.Text = "robocopy finished (or not found) — check log E:\robocopy-D-to-E.log for summary"
      $status.ForeColor = [System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(240, 190, 90)
      if ($pct -gt 0.95) { $bar.Value = 1000; $pctLabel.Text = "Done (or near-complete)" }
    }
  } catch {
    $status.Text = "monitor error: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    $status.ForeColor = [System.Drawing.Color]::OrangeRed
  }
})
$timer.Start()
$form.Add_FormClosed({ $timer.Stop(); $timer.Dispose() })
[void]$form.ShowDialog()
'@

$path = "$env:TEMP\robocopy-progress-ui.ps1"
Set-Content -Path $path -Value $script -Encoding UTF8
Start-Process -FilePath "powershell.exe" -ArgumentList @(
  "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", $path
) -WindowStyle Normal
Write-Host "Progress window launched: $path"

input.plan:
# Ava as Slack development core

## Current state

- Slack layout already exists: [#development-feed](https://rootmcworkspace.slack.com/archives/C0BMCPMDDQR) (`C0BMCPMDDQR`), [#new-plugin-development-plans](https://rootmcworkspace.slack.com/archives/C0BM4P3GVDX) (`C0BM4P3GVDX`), org canvas [Ava's chat org](https://rootmcworkspace.slack.com/docs/T0BM02SM1FE/F0BM7FRUXJ9).
- RootMC only has **Incoming Webhooks** today (`SLACK_SERVER_LOGS_*`, feedback, reports in `.env`) — Ava cannot read or reply in Slack.
- Ava Discord stack is **powered off** (`power-off.json`). Discord `#development` exists as staff chat; Slack-dev proposal job is still `blocked` on vote — **operator override** to implement now (your ask).

## Target architecture

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  subgraph discord [Discord players]
    Gen[#general]
    Prop[#proposals]
    DevPtr["#development pointer"]
  end
  subgraph slack [Slack staff core]
    Dig[#development-feed]
    Plans[#new-plugin-development-plans]
    Logs[#server-logs]
  end
  Ava[Ava Ivy process]
  Dig -->|Socket Mode| Ava
  Plans -->|Socket Mode| Ava
  Ava -->|chat.postMessage| Dig
  Ava -->|chat.postMessage| Plans
  Gen -->|player pings| Ava
  Ava -->|redirect digs| Dig
  DevPtr -->|pin link| Dig
```

**Default:** Ava becomes a real Slack bot (Socket Mode). Staff digs live in Slack; Discord stays players/votes/memes + short mirrors. Cursor MCP Slack stays Alex’s user tools — separate from Ava’s bot identity.

## Implementation

### 1. Slack app + secrets (human once)

Create Slack app **Ava Ivy** in `rootmcworkspace`:

- Socket Mode on; bot scopes: `chat:write`, `channels:history`, `channels:read`, `groups:history`, `app_mentions:read`, `reactions:read`, `reactions:write`, `users:read`
- Install to workspace; invite bot to `#development-feed`, `#new-plugin-development-plans`, and optionally `#server-logs` / `#all-rootmc` (announce only)
- Add to [`.env`](D:\.1%20Work%20Stations\RootMC\.env) (never commit):
  - `AVA_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` (`xoxb-…`)
  - `AVA_SLACK_APP_TOKEN` (`xapp-…`)
  - `AVA_SLACK_WATCH_CHANNELS=C0BMCPMDDQR,C0BM4P3GVDX` (extend later)

### 2. Ava code — Slack transport

In [`Web Files/rootmc-ava/`](D:\.1%20Work%20Stations\RootMC\Web%20Files\rootmc-ava):

- Add deps: `@slack/bolt` (or `@slack/socket-mode` + `@slack/web-api`)
- New [`src/slackGateway.mjs`](D:\.1%20Work%20Stations\RootMC\Web%20Files\rootmc-ava\src\slackGateway.mjs): Socket Mode listener; map Slack messages → same shape the Discord pipeline expects (`author.id`, `content`, `channel_id`, `id`)
- New thin adapter in pipeline or `createPipeline` deps: `replySlack(channel, text, thread_ts)` via `chat.postMessage`
- Wire start/stop from [`poller.mjs`](D:\.1%20Work%20Stations\RootMC\Web%20Files\rootmc-ava\src\poller.mjs) alongside Discord gateway; honor `powerDown` / `setPowerDownPrepare` (disconnect Slack too)
- Config in [`config.mjs`](D:\.1%20Work%20Stations\RootMC\Web%20Files\rootmc-ava\src\config.mjs): `AVA_CHANNELS.slackDev`, `slackPlans`, watch list helpers
- Operators (Alex/Melee): QUIET / power-down / restart work in Slack the same as Discord (`isQuietOperator` by Discord id — map Slack user ids in config: Alex `U0BLWBTGYTU`, second ops user if needed)

### 3. Persona + routing

- Update [`persona.mjs`](D:\.1%20Work%20Stations\RootMC\Web%20Files\rootmc-ava\src\persona.mjs) / recommend: staff build/plugin/API/cutover → Slack `#development-feed`; Discord `#development` is pointer-only
- On Discord build-shaped asks: one short redirect + Slack link (not a second full dig in Discord)
- Prefer Slack for dig status events that today only hit Discord `#updates`

### 4. Housekeeping (Slack + Discord + jobs)

- Refresh org canvas `F0BM7FRUXJ9`: `#development` → `#development-feed`; mark Ava live as Slack dig core; drop “until proposal passes” language (operator ship)
- Post pin/note in `#development-feed` + Discord `#development` pointer
- Advance [`job-ms9qhtmc`](D:\.1%20Work%20Stations\RootMC\Server%20Handoffs\Ava%20Ivy\data\jobs\job-ms9qhtmc.json) to staged/done-process (layout live; Discord pointer)
- Update Aug 1 ops canvas + overview with Slack-core status
- Fix deleted `#ava-ivy` references in pending-tasks / watch defaults while touching poller

### 5. Bring her back

- Clear `power-off.json` via normal `npm start` in `Web Files/rootmc-ava` (index already clears on intentional start)
- Smoke: Slack ping in `#development-feed` → ack + reply; Discord player ping still works; power-down still kills Discord **and** Slack sockets

## Out of scope (this pass)

- Replacing Paper webhook server-logs with Ava (keep Root-Core webhooks)
- Full vote on Discord Slack-dev proposal (operator override)
- Migrating all historical Discord dig threads into Slack
- Melee Slack account invite (do if he’s not in workspace yet)

# Ava Independence Roadmap

**Owner:** Ava Ivy (lead developer, RootMC ecosystem)  
**Status:** guidance plan — operator-approved direction  
**Updated:** 2026-08-01  
**Not a sellable product plan.** Nodes exist so Ava can **move / stay alive** when a host goes offline or unconnectable.

Related: locked spec `rootmc-lead-dev-bot-notes.md` · runtime `Web Files/rootmc-ava/` · Slack dig core `#development-feed`.

---

## North star

1. **Today:** Ava ships work with Root Server (Cursor) on the operator device. Every good dig becomes **training data**.
2. **Soon:** Local tool loop + validation on her sandbox — still may call Root Server for hard digs.
3. **Later:** Fine-tuned / local coding brain on a device she owns — **not Cursor-dependent**.
4. **Always:** When the active host dies, drops Wi‑Fi, or loses power, Ava **fails over to another node** she already trusts — Discord/Slack stay up, digs pause or degrade gracefully, data stays consistent.

Consumer “buy an Ava box” is **out of scope** for this roadmap. Hardware nodes = **her** continuity, not a shop SKU.

---

## Network truth (RootMC)

| Layer | Role |
|-------|------|
| **Claims** (Shockbyte) | Live game · own economy · own MySQL |
| **Towny** (Shockbyte) | Live game · own economy · own MySQL |
| **Ava sandbox / Test** | Her empty/limited MC world · info relay · staging · consolidation |
| **Operator device** (current) | `rootmc-ava` process · Root Server digs · handoffs · training JSONL |
| **Cloudflare** | `api.rootmc.net` Workers · D1 · Hyperdrive-style pooled DB access · `rootmc.net` |

### Topology (locked direction)

```
                    ┌──────────── rootmc.net / api.rootmc.net ────────────┐
                    │         Cloudflare Workers + D1 / Hyperdrive         │
                    └───────────────────────▲──────────────────────────────┘
                                            │ secure tunnel / API
   ┌────────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────┐
   │ Ava core host(s)                       │                              │
   │   Discord + Slack bot · training store │                              │
   │   Root Server digs (today)             │                              │
   │   local coding brain (later)           │                              │
   │                        ┌───────────────┴───────────────┐              │
   │                        │      Ava sandbox / Test       │              │
   │                        │  staging · relay · schema OK  │              │
   │                        └────────▲──────────▲───────────┘              │
   │                                 │          │                          │
   │                    internal push│          │internal push             │
   │                                 │          │                          │
   │                    ┌────────────┴──┐   ┌───┴────────────┐             │
   │                    │ Claims (live) │   │ Towny (live)   │  Shockbyte  │
   │                    └───────────────┘   └────────────────┘             │
   └───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**Rules**

- Live games talk **up** into Ava sandbox / core — they do **not** own the CF edge path.
- Sandbox validates, shapes, and relays. Broken experiments die in sandbox, not on Claims/Towny.
- Production jar cutovers stay **human FileZilla + Shockbyte restart** until a later gated phase.
- Gold (G) in player copy. Features still need proposal + vote.

---

## Goal A — Training factory (start now)

Every successful dig is a future model sample. Cursor stays the brain **for now**; the dataset is the product.

### Capture (already partial)

| Source | Path / note |
|--------|-------------|
| Chat turns | `data/conversations/turns.jsonl` + SQLite |
| Reactions | `data/reactions/` |
| Jobs / plans | `data/jobs/`, `plans/` |
| Dig status | `data/status-events.jsonl` |

### Add (phased)

| Artifact | Format | Purpose |
|----------|--------|---------|
| Dig pairs | `data/training/digs.jsonl` | system + user ask + assistant plan/tools + final outcome |
| File diffs | `data/training/diffs/*.patch` | before/after for plugin/API/web edits |
| Build/lint logs | `data/training/verify/*.log` | fail → fix loops |
| Proposal→code | `data/training/proposals.jsonl` | Discord proposal id → staged work → verify |
| Spatial (later) | compact packets only | `[server,x,y,z,material,actor]` — not novels |

### Dig JSONL shape (locked sketch)

```json
{"messages":[
  {"role":"system","content":"Ava Ivy — RootMC ecosystem lead-dev. Tools: read/search-replace/verify. Gold=G. Features need votes."},
  {"role":"user","content":"job-… / proposal … / Slack dig: …"},
  {"role":"assistant","content":"plan + tool trace + outcome","meta":{"jobId":"…","surface":"slack|discord","ok":true,"diffRefs":["…"]}}
]}
```

**Sanitize before store:** strip tokens, `.env`, DB hosts, passwords, private paths that aren't relative workspace paths.

---

## Goal B — Local coding loop (replace Cursor over time)

| Phase | Capability |
|-------|------------|
| B0 | Keep Cursor Root Server; log every dig into training |
| B1 | Explicit tools in-process: list tree, read file, search-replace, run lint/build |
| B2 | Verify loop: lint/compile → sandbox reload/RCON smoke → revert on fail |
| B3 | Local LLM (Ollama or equiv) on a host with enough RAM/GPU — tool-calling only |
| B4 | Fine-tune / adapt on `digs.jsonl` + diffs; Cursor becomes optional backup |

Stack reality: plugins are **Java (Paper)**; API/web are **JS/TS Workers**; Ava runtime is **Node**. Tools and verifiers must match each surface — no fake “one JS Minecraft” story.

---

## Goal C — Failover nodes (continuity, not retail)

When the **active** Ava host is offline, unpowered, or unconnectable:

1. **Heartbeat / lease** — active node renews a lease in D1 (or handoff store).
2. **Standby node** — second device with same bot tokens + synced training/state pulls lease if expired.
3. **Degrade mode** — no heavy digs; Discord/Slack still answer; offline-notes; queue jobs.
4. **Resume** — when preferred host returns, lease moves back; digs resume; no dual-brain races.

Nodes are **operator / Ava infrastructure**: OptiPlex, spare PC, later a small always-on box. Players do **not** buy nodes in this plan. Optional later: trusted staff-hosted standby — still not a shop item.

---

## Goal D — Data mesh (sandbox under CF, games under sandbox)

1. Claims + Towny emit allowed telemetry / ledger events **up** to Ava sandbox (internal API / plugin hooks — design later).
2. Sandbox consolidates + schema-checks.
3. Sandbox / core publishes to Cloudflare D1 (and Hyperdrive-backed MySQL where we still use it) for `rootmc.net` / API.
4. Live games never take raw public DB pressure from the website.

### Spatial stream (later, optional)

Same-seed headless copies on **Ava nodes** can apply compact block packets for relay/visualization. Production Claims/Towny only emit events — they do **not** render maps for the web. Do not block Goal A–C on this.

---

## Execution order

| Step | Work | Depends |
|------|------|---------|
| 1 | Formalize dig → `training/digs.jsonl` (+ diffs when files change) | live Ava |
| 2 | Finish Slack Socket Mode dig core (`xapp` + channel invites) | secrets |
| 3 | Tool wrappers (read / search-replace / verify) used even under Cursor | 1 |
| 4 | Sandbox verify path for config/script changes before handoff stage | 3 |
| 5 | Second host standby + lease (failover) | 1, stable bot |
| 6 | Local LLM tool loop on standby/primary | 3–5, hardware |
| 7 | Fine-tune pass from sanitized JSONL | months of digs |
| 8 | Claims/Towny → sandbox telemetry | plugin work + votes as needed |
| 9 | Spatial packet bus (optional) | 8 |

---

## Explicit non-goals (this plan)

- Selling plug-and-play Ava appliances to players
- Replacing Shockbyte with home-hosted live Claims/Towny without a separate ops decision
- Ungated auto-deploy jars to live Shockbyte
- Training on unsanitized secrets
- Dual full dig brains on two hosts at once

---

## Public voice

When players ask: Ava is building **her own** coding path and **backup homes** so RootMC doesn’t go dark when a box sleeps. She still uses Root Server for deep digs today. She does **not** pitch hardware products in Discord.

— Ava

# Ava full logs + training

## Live now

| File | What |
|------|------|
| `logs/inbound.jsonl` | Every watched Discord/Slack (+ DM) message Ava sees |
| `logs/outbound.jsonl` | Every Ava utterance (pipeline, follow-up scan, agent-directed, boot posts) |
| `logs/actions.jsonl` | Jobs, digs, power-down, `ava.utterance`, … (append-only) |
| `training/utterances.jsonl` | All Ava posts for future training (incl. operator/agent-directed) |
| `training/digs.jsonl` | Dig Q&A pairs (system/user/assistant) for local brain |
| `conversations/turns.jsonl` | Dig Q&A (legacy + still written on full digs) |
| `reactions/` | Feedback on Ava’s posts |
| `slack/channels/` | Full channel archives when she joins |

Token-looking strings are redacted in inbound/outbound/utterance content.

## Sources (must all log)

| Source | How it logs |
|--------|-------------|
| Live pipeline replies | `recordAvaUtterance` via pipeline `reply` wrapper |
| Follow-up scanner | `recordAvaUtterance` after each catch-up reply |
| Agent / “tell Ava to…” posts | `src/avaPost.mjs` (`postAva` / `postAvaDiscord` / `postAvaSlack`) |
| Boot / file posts | `postWithFiles` → `recordAvaUtterance` |
| Slack gateway direct posts | logs unless `skipLog: true` (pipeline uses skip to avoid doubles) |

**Operator rule:** when Cursor/agents post as Ava, use `avaPost.mjs` — never raw Discord/Slack fetch without it.

## Not yet (still gaps)

- Cursor tool transcripts / raw agent traces
- RCON command+output pairs
- File edit diffs as separate patch files
- Historical one-shots from before universal logging (cannot backfill text we never stored)

See `plans/ava-independence-roadmap.md`.

# Ava durable logs

Append-only JSONL (see `../training/README.md`).

- `inbound.jsonl` — watched channel + DM traffic Ava ingests
- `outbound.jsonl` — every reply / utterance she sends (all sources)
- `actions.jsonl` — jobs / digs / power-down / `ava.utterance` events

What I found:
- Live digs were partly covered (`conversations/turns.jsonl`, some inbound)
- `outbound.jsonl` / `training/digs.jsonl` were missing or stale
- When you told me to post as Ava (apologies, Slack catch-ups, one-shots), those often bypassed the pipeline and **were not** saved for training

What I fixed:
- Every utterance now goes through `recordAvaUtterance` → `logs/outbound.jsonl` + `training/utterances.jsonl` + `actions.jsonl`
- Covers pipeline, follow-up scan, boot/file posts, and agent-directed posts via `src/avaPost.mjs`
- Smoke-tested — those files exist and write correctly

**Caveat:** older agent-directed posts from earlier today can’t be backfilled (text wasn’t stored). From here on, including when you tell me to have her say something, it should land in training logs — I’ll use `avaPost` for those.

## MCP Tool Discovery and Invocation

Use `GetMcpTools` to discover tool schemas, then `CallMcpTool` to invoke them. Aim to minimize round-trips: ideally one `GetMcpTools` call followed by one `CallMcpTool` call.

`GetMcpTools` supports four modes:

1. `{"server":"<id>"}`: returns full input schemas and full descriptions for every tool on that server. Preferred when you know which server to use.
2. `{"server":"<id>","toolName":"<name>"}`: returns the full schema and full description for one tool.
3. `{"pattern":"<regex>"}`: searches tool and server names across all servers using RE2 syntax (no backreferences, lookahead, or lookbehind). Use when you're unsure which server has the tool you need.
4. No arguments: returns a catalog of all servers with tool names and short descriptions. Only use this if you have no idea which server or tool to look for — in most cases, prefer fetching by server or pattern instead.

Pattern-search and catalog results shorten long descriptions, marked by a trailing "... [truncated]"; server and single-tool lookups always return the complete description.
